label: PF Backlog 635
title: Skill/guideline prompt injection (SKILLS: block)
body:
## Problem / why
Python never injects skill bodies, so skills stay harness-bound.

## Goal & value
Agents receive applicable skills through PF's own prompt builder.

## In scope
- Edit core/orchestrator/agent_runner.py to add a SKILLS: block via the neutral resolver.
- Edit core/knowledge_compliance_checker.py GuidelineContentLoader to load skill bodies from pipeline/skills.
- Honor the skill-router token-budget protocol.

## Out of scope
- Changing agent model routing.

## Definition of Done
- Agent prompt snapshot test asserts the SKILLS: block.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
